title: Receiver reset-on-done allows state injection
description:
File: rust/lichen-schc/src/fragment.rs
Lines: 817-826

Issue: After completing a transfer (done=true), receiving any valid fragment resets the receiver and starts accepting the new fragment. This allows an attacker to corrupt the storage buffer after a legitimate transfer completes but before the caller retrieves the packet.

Trigger: After a legitimate transfer completes, attacker immediately sends fragments with new rule_id. The receiver resets and accepts attacker data, overwriting storage buffer.

Impact: The legitimate completed packet in self.storage is corrupted. If the caller has not yet called packet(), they receive attacker-controlled data.

Suggested fix: Either require explicit release() call before accepting new transfers, return an error when receiving data while done=true, or copy completed packet to separate buffer before reset.
close_reason: Fixed: Receiver now rejects fragments when done && packet_len.is_some(), preventing attacker state injection. Added TransferComplete error, security comments, and updated tests.
